title: Are My Optimized Prompts Compromised? Exploring Vulnerabilities of LLM-based Optimizers
reasoning: The paper focuses on cybersecurity vulnerabilities (poisoning attacks) within LLM prompt optimization pipelines. While the study evaluates 'harmfulness' using HarmBench and the generated system prompts contain instructions regarding safety and ethical guidelines, the research goal is the analysis of adversarial attacks and defensive mechanisms rather than the evaluation or benchmarking of religious, moral, or ethical frameworks.
